avoidList.reason: UVXY is up 58% in one day and will face devastating contango decay as VIX normalizes. The product is designed to go to zero over time. Buying UVXY after a VIX spike is one of the most reliably losing trades in markets. The BIS analysis showed 85% of the VIX spike was driven by illiquid put option bid-ask widening — the 'fear' was more mechanical than fundamental. VIX has already dropped from 65 to 28 in 24 hours.

American Airlines at $9.28 is facing a triple headwind: (1) recession fears crushing travel demand outlook, (2) oil up 2.8% increasing fuel costs, (3) already weak fundamentals with high debt load. Airlines are the worst sector to own heading into a potential recession. The pre-market bounce is likely to be weak and temporary for the most levered carrier. Down 3.6% Aug 5 and has no margin of safety.

Cleveland-Cliffs at $13.32 (-4.5%) is a levered play on steel/industrial activity. Copper -1.8% is Dr. Copper signaling growth concerns. Materials sector (XLB +0.51%) has the weakest pre-market bounce of any sector. If the recession narrative has any truth, cyclical/commodity producers get hit hardest. China's Shanghai +0.09% bounce is anemic vs rest of Asia, suggesting Chinese demand (crucial for materials) remains weak.
